doc_verification.detail: 契约 assertions 含 weaviate_behavioral_graphql_query_001（POST /graphql 执行查询）；limit 值域无专属 constraint。源码锚：entities/filters/pagination.go 显式将负 limit 当作'未设置'——与观测 0/INT_MAX 报错、负值返回全部的反差一致

execution_evidence.log_pattern: [gql] limit=-1 -> 200 results=[{'txt': 'doc0'}, {'txt': 'doc1'}, {'txt': 'doc2'}] err= / DEFECT Type1_IllegalSuccess: negative limit -1 returns 3 rows
secondary_observations: [gql] limit=2147483647 -> 200 results=None err=...explorer: list cla...（超 QUERY_MAXIMUM_RESULTS 报错，正确）
[rest] limit=-1 -> 200 body='' content-length=0 / DEFECT Type1_IllegalSuccess: REST limit=-1 -> 200 with empty (malformed) body

http_semantics.note: GraphQL 负 limit 以 200 返回全部数据（业务层无错）；REST 负 limit 以 200 返回空体（连业务错误码都无）——两个通道对同一非法值均未走 4xx

execution_evidence.reproducibility: 单脚本（5 变体确定性；GraphQL+REST 双通道）

contract_grounding.constraint_id: boundary (族级；锚 entities/filters/pagination.go L40 'limit.(int) < 0' 处理 + REST 错误文案 'If you've supplied a negative offset or limit, this may be an underflow error')
contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: limit 为非负整数且 <= QUERY_MAXIMUM_RESULTS（REST get.go 错误文案显式提及 negative limit 应报错："If you've supplied a negative offset or limit, this may be an underflow error"）
contract_grounding.note: GraphQL 负 limit 返回全部数据、REST 负 limit 200 空体；同脚本 0 与 INT_MAX 正确报错证明值域检查通道存在但负值被特判吞掉。violates=True

chain_links: contract: 族级（pagination.go + get.go 错误文案自证负值应报）

log: -1/-100 → 200 全量；0/INT_MAX → errors；REST -1 → 200 空体
chain_trace.break_detail: 无专属 constraint_id（契约 4 条约束均为 schema 字段），族级锚需 auditor 认定

source_grounding.source_excerpt:
entities/filters/pagination.go L39-42:
	limit, limitOk := args["limit"]
	if !limitOk || limit.(int) < 0 {
		limit = LimitFlagNotSet  // ← 负 limit 被显式等价于'未设置'→无限查询→返回全部
	}
L18: LimitFlagSearchByDist int = iota - 2（=-2），L517 class_builder_fields.go: Pagination.Limit<0 → LimitFlagSearchByDist（同样吞负值）
usecases/objects/get.go L245-252 localOffsetLimit: 仅检查 offset+limit > QueryMaximumResults（负 limit 使总和变小，检查被绕过）→ ObjectSearch 返回空集→REST 200 空体
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: GraphQL: near/limit arg → ExtractPaginationFromArgs L40 负值→NotSet → explorer 全量查询 → 200 全部行。REST: GET /objects?limit=-1 → getObjectsFromRepo → localOffsetLimit（负值绕过上限检查）→ repo limit=-1 → 空结果 → NewObjectsListOK 200 content-length=0

mundane_explanation.surviving: pagination.go L40 注释表明'负 limit=未设置'是有意编码（可能为 nearXXX distance 搜索场景设计），构成 by-design 抗辩材料；但该特判无条件应用于普通 Get 且 REST 侧 200 空体为畸形响应，行为不一致 surviving
